verdicts.reason: A shrinks the hero product to a tiny shoe stuck at the bottom edge, leaving the circle empty behind the text. The GROVE wordmark sits under the headline, the 'Find It Near You' CTA is a tiny pill that the tilted FREE DELIVERY badge outshines, and the SUMMER ONLY badge collides with the circle's top. B keeps the product at a readable size but has its own problems: the headline and body copy run across the circle's edge, the SUMMER ONLY badge has shrunk until it can't be read, GROVE again sits under the headline, and the bottom row jams three pills together with a weak CTA. Even so, B keeps the key imagery, so it is the less broken of the two.
